items.rationale: One travel charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f); priced at the reference level of about 81.
Sealing and consumable material is covered under 7.1.7(c); case 39 accepted at least 24.
Like-for-like pipe replacement is a necessary repair cost; reference about 40 per m.
Standard insulation that formed part of the installation is covered under 7.1.7(c); reference about 23 per m.
Installer labour is covered under 7.1.7(g); case 39 accepted at least 76 for one installer hour. Some risk it duplicates the technician hours.
Labour for the repair is covered under 7.1.7(g); case 39 accepted at least 732 for 9 hours.
Drying needed before the repair is covered under 7.1.7(b)/(e), one flat rate per drying operation; references at least 403 and at least 580.

items.description: Painting disturbed area and closing opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening is covered under 7.1.7(a); references at least 416 and at least 633.

items.description: Full repaint of entire wall 8 m²
items.rationale: Only the patch was affected and the same paint was still available, so the 7.1.6 continuous-surface extension does not apply; 7.1.5(a) excludes repainting for a matching appearance.
Unaffected separate surfaces are excluded under 7.1.5 and 7.1.6.
